title: A nicer voltmeter clock
summary: This article describes a creative electronics project where vintage voltmeter movements are repurposed to display time as a clock, with the needle position indicating hours and minutes through electronic signal manipulation rather than traditional digital displays.
problem_solved: Transforms obsolete analog voltmeter instruments into functional, aesthetically unique timekeeping devices.
why_valuable: Combines nostalgia for vintage analog equipment with modern electronics know-how to create one-of-a-kind decorative pieces that serve a practical purpose.
